_comment: Map Phase 3.5 proof C — THE RADIUS-VS-FOG SHOT: low-altitude horizon view from just off the west coast looking WEST across open water toward the streamed window edge (orbit places the camera at center+[radius,height,0] looking at center, i.e. looking −x). With radius 14 the nearest window edge sits ~672 m out — past the Phase-3.4 fog knee (63% at 600 m) — so the edge must dissolve into the sky-matched haze instead of popping as a hard terrain rim (the ≤8-tile cap put that edge at ~384 m, only ~1/3 fogged). This is the render the 14-vs-fog decision was made against.
